result.title: MedHarness: A Unified Budgeted Runtime for Reliable Medical Imaging Agents
result.summary: Medical imaging agents already return answers on heterogeneous imaging surfaces, yet deployment still faces a limited verification budget where each wrong accept can harm clinical trust. When a thin check and a deeper evidence pass disagree on the same case, deciding when to stop, open more evidence, repair, or reject without a shared controller remains ill-posed. Tool-using workflows often lock a surface-specific evidence order per dataset, or a private always-open full-depth verification path; those pipelines stay costly, leave many wrong accepts, and cannot share one controller across modalities. We present MedHarness, a registered multi-surface runtime reliability layer that reformulates post-answer control as shared decision-object attachment after a proposer's initial prediction. Under Shared Decision Object, Minimum-Sufficient Verification, and Intermediate Repair, one shared policy with surface recipe adapters lets a new imaging surface join the same stop / open-evidence / repair / reject controller by recipe registration. On a 512-case live pool, MedHarness cuts wrong accepts versus a full-verification baseline by about 47% and raises accepted accuracy to 83.2% vs. 72.9% at 86.1% coverage versus full release under that baseline. On a failure-enriched multi-surface stress ranking, the same controller cuts estimated remote service calls per case by about 71% versus that baseline under a matched context-load setting. A held-out three-surface check and an alternate language-model transfer keep the same control ordering. The code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/MedHarness-paper-release-A7F3/.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 MedHarness：一个面向医学影像 agent 的注册式运行时可靠性层，在 proposer 给出初始答案后，用同一共享策略在有限验证预算下决定停止、追加证据、修复或拒答，并在多影像模态与压力排序上报告错误接受率与调用成本。
AI.relevance_reason: 直接对应「LOOK/STOP 的收益与成本」与停止决策问题：其「最小充分验证」、预算化证据开放和拒答阈值可供核查多模态推理中何时结束验证；但论文聚焦外部工具控制层，未涉及内部 latent 状态表示，联系主要在控制与评价侧。
